name: Suspension Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Face away from the anchor, secure one foot in the low cradle and plant your other foot ahead of you.
Brace your core, keep your torso tall, and bend your front knee to lower your hips smoothly down as your back leg glides slightly backward.
Descend until your front thigh approaches parallel to the floor while keeping your front heel grounded.
Drive firmly through your front foot to stand tall again, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Avoid pushing heavily into the rear strap; keep almost all your weight balanced through your front leg.
Track your front knee straight over your toes and maintain steady hips throughout.
